{{Top|leg}}
'''Veriss Creek''' was a small, shallow river located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Freliq]]. It was possibly a site of crop production, as agriculture was widespread on Freliq.<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
